mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1100 thousand units signal weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS) and industrial production decline (INDPRO) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth decelerates and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) trigger Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightening, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint deceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 growth decelerates and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 500000 million dollars) drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
